2. Covered kiosks or similar covered structures located within the covered mall building shall be provided with an approved automatic sprinkler system and detection devices where required by the New York City Fire Code and Section 903.3.3 of this code.

3. The horizontal separation between kiosks or groupings thereof and other similar structures within the mall shall be not less than 20 feet (6096 mm).

4. Each kiosk or similar structure or groupings thereof shall have an area not greater than 300 square feet (28 m 2 ).
